newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Argo Pantes raises FRN to US$33 mln.
newsitem.headline: PT Argo Pantes raises FRN to US$33 mln.

text.p: PT Argo Pantes' floating rate note issue has been increased to US$33 million from US$25 million, arranger Societe Generale Asia said on Friday.
The three-year facility was priced at par to float at 160 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 75 basis points for co-lead managers and 60 basis points for managers.
The deal was issued off the borrower's US$250 million Medium Term Note programme.
Societe Generale Asia is the arranger.
Union Bank of Switzerland, Singapore is the co-arranger.
Malayan Banking Berhad, Singapore and Korean French Banking Corp are co-lead managers.
AB Capital Markets HK, Coryo Merchant Bank, Gyongnam Merchant Banking Corp, Kumho Merchant Bank and Shinhan Investment Bank are managers.
